§6Arsenic Bronze§f

§aDrop-in bismuth bronze replacement. Same recipes, cheaper ingredients.§f

§bArsenic Bronze§f is a copper-arsenic alloy that swaps into nearly every bismuth bronze recipe. If bismuth is scarce, this is your answer.

§6Make It§f (Crucible):
§b•§f 8 Copper Nuggets + 1 Arsenic Nugget + 3 Flux
§b•§f Output: §e1 Arsenic Bronze Ingot§f + 3 Slag Nuggets

§6Where It Replaces Bismuth Bronze§f:
§b•§f §eTier 5 Anvil§f, iron anvil + 10 arsenic bronze ingots
§b•§f §ePlasma Forge§f, same recipe, swap the cast plate
§b•§f §eHeavy Duty Element§f, plasma forge recipe
§b•§f §eMHD Turbine§f, high-end power component
§b•§f §eICF Reactor§f, cast plates
§b•§f §eOverdrive Upgrade Mk.III§f, replaces bismuth bronze
§b•§f Laser rifle bronze parts

§ePS:§f Direct swap in most cases. If your recipe calls for cast bismuth bronze plate, try cast arsenic bronze plate. Check JEI to confirm the specific recipe accepts it.
